name: formal-gates
description: Agent Skill compatible formal workflow package with a default one-time reminder, an on-request formal flow, and a record-only lightweight route. Core skill documents are runtime-neutral; bundled installer and hook targets are Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness. Go package validation is cross-platform. Hook enforcement must be verified per host with a live canary.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.caveat: Install the installable skill subset as a Claude skill; command hook support requires configured settings and a live canary on Claude Code.

hosts.name: Codex
hosts.caveat: Install the installable skill subset as a Codex skill. PreToolUse hook enforcement still requires a live canary on Codex. This package does not claim Codex plugin distribution.

hosts.name: Cursor
hosts.caveat: Install Cursor hook support through hooks.json; hook enforcement requires a live canary on Cursor.

hosts.name: DeepSeek Harness
hosts.caveat: Install the skill under the DeepSeek Harness home and mount a small bundled Cordis plugin through the home cordis.patch.yml; hook enforcement requires a live canary on DeepSeek Harness.

hosts.name: Gemini
hosts.caveat: Gemini may use the readable workflow guidance if its environment supports equivalent instruction loading; this package ships no Gemini installer or hook target.

hosts.name: OpenCode
hosts.caveat: OpenCode may use the readable workflow guidance if its environment supports equivalent instruction loading; this package ships no OpenCode installer or hook target.

hosts.name: Windsurf
hosts.caveat: Windsurf may use the readable workflow guidance if its environment supports equivalent instruction loading; this package ships no Windsurf installer or hook target.

validation_notes: The built formal-gates native binary is the installed package and artifact validation entrypoint for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The native canary command validates package shape, the file-driven prompt catalog, hook decisions, workflow state, and install shape without PowerShell.
GateRunner loads the shared reviewer base and every valid package-local gate prompt from the prompt catalog without a per-gate manifest or Go registry.
Native workflow commands resolve and verify immutable identities through the selected Git, SVN, or P4 command while reviewers inspect native comparisons directly.
Native install copies the verifiable installable package subset, including prompts and gates, without PS1/Python script runtime files and writes each selected host's native hook configuration.

Native install and uninstall use the single marker-delimited host-instruction block from SKILL.md for the applicable Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness guidance files; Cursor global has no host-instruction file.
Source checkout builds are read-only candidate validation inputs; install/bootstrap/uninstall and workflow writes must use the registry-admitted fixed stable launcher.
The native Codex hook canary uses formal-gates canary codex-hook; same-host hook blocking still requires live canary evidence.
verification_commands contains only repo-local commands runnable from this package root.

Native install also writes the DeepSeek Harness skill under .dsh/skills and mounts the bundled minimal Cordis hook plugin through the DSH home cordis.patch.yml; project-scope DSH installs skills and AGENTS.md instructions only because DSH loads only the home-level patch layer.
The native DeepSeek Harness hook path uses the same generic hook decide protocol through the bundled dsh_plugin.mjs adapter and still requires live canary evidence before claiming blocking.

Stage-0 native installation owns the immutable release copy, cross-process lock, one recovery journal, backup, stable launcher, host configuration, and registry commit; shell and PowerShell bootstrap entries only download, verify, stage the fixed launcher, and invoke that owner.
Stage-0 package validation uses Lstat/realpath and deterministic SHA-256 receipts and rejects package entries that resolve through a symlink to a mutable worktree.
support_caveats: Core skill documents may be read by other Agent Skill compatible runtimes, but only Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness have bundled installer/hook target entries.
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Gemini, OpenCode, and Windsurf are described by readable-skill, install-guidance, hook-configuration, and live-canary-proven blocking capability levels.
Hook enforcement claims require live canary evidence on the specific host.
A passing canary on one host does not prove another host. Do not claim Codex or DeepSeek Harness plugin distribution from this package.
release_trust: Phase 1 CI is configured to produce CI artifacts and platform-specific SHA256 checksum files, and to upload them when a GitHub Release is published.
Phase 1 does not ship artifact attestation, npm provenance, signing, or equivalent third-party release-trust evidence.
Phase 2 must define and implement signing, provenance, or equivalent release-trust evidence before public release claims rely on those controls.
